test_vote_module_forward_pass: test the VoteModule forward pass with seed_xyz and seed_features to produce vote_xyz, vote_features, and vote_offset
test_vote_module_chamfer_distance_loss: test the VoteModule configured with a ChamferDistance vote_loss using l1 mode and loss_dst_weight of 10.0
test_vote_module_vote_per_seed: test the VoteModule with vote_per_seed set to 3 to generate 3 votes per seed point
test_vote_module_clip_offset: test the VoteModule with vote_xyz_range clipping offsets to a specified range like (2.0, 2.0, 2.0)
test_vote_module_without_feature_residua: test the VoteModule with with_res_feat set to False to disable the feature residual connection
